messages:
Devon (People Ops): @here quick update on team structure + manager changes — please read. We're splitting Ops into two focused squads: Platform Ops (infra-facing) and Customer Ops (SRE + onboarding). Effective 2026-03-30.
Aisha Patel: I’ll be moving to lead Platform Ops starting 3/30. Happy to take ownership of infra runbooks and platform-oncall handoffs. :party:
Liam O'Connor: Congrats Aisha! I’ll serve as interim manager for Customer Ops while we recruit — will handle day-to-day and hiring cadence.
Maya Chen: Thanks for the heads up. Any changes to reporting lines or oncall shifts we should expect immediately?
Aisha Patel: Short answer: minimal disruption. Running oncall schedule stays same this week; I'll coordinate a gradual handoff of runbooks to Platform Ops next week. Liam — can we sync on incident rotation adjustments?
Liam O'Connor: Yep — I'll patch the rota tonight and post before EOD. Also will take ownership of customer escalation playbook until hire is onboarded.
Ben Torres: I’ll update the service ownership docs and add Aisha to the infra-alerts ACLs. Flag me if I should pause any rotations during transfer.
Devon (People Ops): Hiring plan: we’re opening a req for a permanent Customer Ops Manager today. Target interview cycle = 4–6 weeks. Interview panel will include Maya (tech lead), Ben (SRE), and Liam (hiring manager). Please DM me referrals.
Aisha Patel: I’ll prepare a 30/60/90 doc and drop it in the team drive by tomorrow to speed onboarding for the new hire.
Liam O'Connor: I’ll schedule a 1:1 transfer session with Aisha (45m) for knowledge transfer — invite sent.
Devon (People Ops): Action items: 1) Liam update rota (today). 2) Aisha post 30/60/90 (by 3/24). 3) People Ops open req + post to internal jobs (today). 4) Panel: Maya/Ben/Liam. Questions -> DM Devon. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
HRbot: Reminder — please submit the org change form in Workday by 2026-03-25 to ensure payroll and access updates.
